notes.title: Frank and Drake - OUT NOW!
notes.content:
After nearly three years of work, the next narrative game by Appnormals just launched!
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1530800/Frank_and_Drake/]'Frank and Drake'[/url] is OUT NOW'[/b] and features:

[list]
[*] Dual narrative where you play both characters: Frank (day) and Drake (night)
[*] 8000+ frames individually drawn over footage (rotoscoping technique)
[*] 40+ minigames and puzzles scattered through the game
[*] 6 endings and different routes so you can replay and change your choices
[*] Multiple locations of Oriole City with 200+ backgrounds
[/list]

The reviews so far have been incredible, with so many beautiful words about it. Some examples:

A Couple of Gamers: 10/10
Gamerheads Podcast: 10/10
Six One indie: 9/10
The Gaming Outsider: 9/10
SVG: 8/10
Pocket Tactics: 8/10
WGTC: 8/10

[previewyoutube=83wxb7IFMdY;full][/previewyoutube]

If you enjoyed the uniqueness of [b]STAY[/b], we can assure you:  [b]'Frank and Drake'[/b] will be your cup of tea, at the end of the day t is made by the same authors!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1530800/Frank_and_Drake/]Check out the Steam page[/url]

If you play it, also remember to [b]write a review![/b] It is very important for small humble new games to gain visibility on the platform. Thanks in advance!

Welcome to Oriole City. Introducing the story of Frank and Drake : )

notes.title: New game: FRANK AND DRAKE
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We hope you're all well and safe during these crazy times, please take care!

On our side, we have been working really hard for the past couple of years on a new narrative game after STAY. Still a lot of work to do, but we are happy to finally introduce our next project: it is called [b]FRANK AND DRAKE[/b], it is planned to launch this coming fall and it has a Steam page live!

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1530800/Frank_and_Drake/]FRANK AND DRAKE on Steam[/url][/b]

[b]FRANK AND DRAKE[/b] is a modern take on the classic novels of [i]Frankenstein [/i]and [i]Dracula[/i], with two housemates inspired by their iconic characters. They will have different time cycles and we will play both characters sequentially: Frank during the day, Drake during the night. In consequence, they will not bump into each other ever, and their relationship will develop through sticky notes and other written messages.

One remarkable aspect of the game is the visuals, using the rotoscoping technique: we draw frame by frame (yes, very time-consuming!) over footage from real actors, giving the game that uncanny and surreal aspect that fits the narrative so well. We really hope you like it!

If you want to stay tuned for more game updates and want to support our work, please do consider [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1530800/Frank_and_Drake]adding it to your wishlist[/url][/b]! It means a huge help for a small studio like us. 

Thanks in advance! 
Cheers,

Appnormals Team

notes.title: STAY wins "Best Original Idea" at Spanish Videogame Awards 2018
notes.content:
We're excited to share that STAY has won 'Best Original Idea' at the Spanish Videogame Industry Awards celebrated in Gamelab Barcelona!

These awards praise not only the most relevant indie titles but AAA games as well. Besides this award, STAY was nominated in three other categories: Best Narrative, Best PC Game, and Best Console Game.

Full list of winners and nominees here (in Spanish) here: https://www.vidaextra.com/eventos/bring-you-home-se-corona-como-mejor-juego-ano-xi-premios-nacionales-industria-videojuego

There's still time to pick up STAY and the Original Soundtrack for 20% off in the Steam Summer sale (ending 5 July).

notes.title: STAY Skip Function
notes.content:
In response to numerous player comments, Appnormals are planning the implementation of a feature that will allow players to skip puzzle sections for subsequent playthroughs. 

A button at the top right corner of the screen will appear once the player has completed the game at least once, which will complete the current puzzle and allow players to continue on with the story.
